title: Terrace (terraces/items/<id>/terrace.json)
description: What a terrace, a patio or a deck is covered with, as the house view lays it flat over the outline drawn for it: decking, tiles, stone, concrete. Its texture is painted from a few numbers, like the surface of a path.

draft.description: Colour of the terrace on the overlay of the editor, where it is drawn flat and bright rather than lit.

thickness.description: How far the terrace stands over the ground levelled under it, in metres: a few centimetres for tiles on a slab, more for a deck on joists. The user may change it.

surface.description: What is seen from above. The rows of its units run across the laying direction the user gives the terrace, so the boards of a deck follow that direction.
